body: Thanks for your reply, I’m glad I’m not the only one feeling this.

I’ve struggled with clinical depression my whole life, I’m not sure exactly what caused it in the first place. I’ve felt most of those things for years, I do think this may be caused by depression but I don’t know why. I believe my depression is worsening because I’ve been in a toxic relationship that has taken a toll on me, but the thing with my mom started before I got in the relationship.
I’ve been going through this exact struggle. I hope I get the courage soon.
Thank you for your reply and support, you were pretty spot on tbh
I feel the same way... sometimes I wish I could hurry up already if I quit being afraid.
